items.question: How many programmes does Youth 4 Sustainability (Y4S) have?
items.gold: Two: Future Sustainability Leaders and Sustainability Ambassadors.
items.fact: Y4S has two programmes: Future Sustainability Leaders and Sustainability Ambassadors.

items.question: Are straws packed with drink packages exempt from the UAE single-use plastic ban?
items.gold: Yes, straws packed with drink packages are not banned.
items.fact: Straws packed with drink packages are exempt from the single-use plastic ban.
